gifts.title: A Test Letter
gifts.note: If you can read this, the mailbox works. Dev builds only: nobody else will ever see this one.

gifts.title: A Ten-Pull on Us
gifts.note: Dorf 5.0 is here, and every level counts now. Whether you brought your old save along or started over at the edge of the Whispering Woods, this ten-pull is on us. Thank you for climbing with us, and tell us how the new climb feels.

gifts.title: Another Ten-Pull on Us
gifts.note: Dorf 5.1 is here, and the Underground Morass has started listening. This ten-pull is on us, with our thanks for playing and for telling us how it feels.
